cac = dataset[''cac'']
df = dataset
df = df.rename(columns = {''enrollment_cohort'': ''Enrollment Cohort''})
df = df.sort_values(by=[''Enrollment Cohort'', ''monthsSinceEnrollment''])
df[''deltaGrossSales''] = np.maximum(df[''orderGrossSales''] - df[''firstOrderGrossSales''], 0)

g = df.groupby([''Enrollment Cohort'', ''monthsSinceEnrollment'']).agg(
    everActivatedCustomers = (''everActivatedCustomers'', ''max''), 
    totalRevenue = (''totalRevenue'', ''sum''), 
    rabbitRevenue = (''rabbitRevenue'', ''sum''),
    grossSales = (''orderGrossSales'', ''sum''), 
    deltaGrossSales = (''deltaGrossSales'', ''sum'')
).reset_index()


g[''originalInvestment''] = cac * g[''everActivatedCustomers'']

g[''cumulativeTotalRevenue''] = g.groupby(''Enrollment Cohort'')[''totalRevenue''].cumsum()
g[''margenAjustado''] = g[''rabbitRevenue''] + 0.2 * g[''deltaGrossSales''] 
g[''cumulativeRabbitRevenue''] = g.groupby(''Enrollment Cohort'')[''rabbitRevenue''].cumsum()
g[''cumulativeRabbitMargenAjustado''] = g.groupby(''Enrollment Cohort'')[''margenAjustado''].cumsum()
g[''cumulativeRabbitMargenAjustado''] = g[''cumulativeRabbitMargenAjustado''] - g[''originalInvestment'']

g[''returnOnInvestmentPropaga''] = g[''cumulativeTotalRevenue''] / g[''originalInvestment'']
g[''returnOnInvestmentRabbit''] = g[''cumulativeRabbitRevenue'']-g[''originalInvestment'']

g[''Cohort | Activations''] = g[''Enrollment Cohort''] + '' | '' + g[''everActivatedCustomers''].astype(str)


wavg = g.groupby([''monthsSinceEnrollment'']).agg(
    originalInvestment = (''originalInvestment'', ''sum''),
    everActivatedCustomers = (''everActivatedCustomers'', ''sum''), 
    cumulativeRabbitRevenue = (''cumulativeRabbitRevenue'', ''sum''), 
    cumulativeRabbitMargenAjustado = (''cumulativeRabbitMargenAjustado'', ''sum''),
    cohorts = (''Enrollment Cohort'', ''count'')
).reset_index()

wavg[''cumulativeRabbitMargenAjustado''] = wavg[''cumulativeRabbitMargenAjustado''] / wavg[''cohorts'']
